# iFlow Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native iFlow configuration. The main output is `.iflow/rules/project.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - iflow
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - iflow:
      version: full
```

## At a Glance

| Property          | Value                                 |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 3                                |
| **Main output**   | `.iflow/rules/project.md`             |
| **Dot directory** | `.iflow/`                             |
| **Skills**        | Yes (`.iflow/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) |
| **Agents**        | No                                    |
| **Commands**      | No                                    |
| **Local files**   | No                                    |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                            | Purpose                    |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Main instructions | `.iflow/rules/project.md`       | Primary rule file          |
| Skills            | `.iflow/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Reusable skill definitions |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                                     |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .iflow/rules/project.md file                        |
| `multifile`      | Single .iflow/rules/project.md file (skills via full mode) |
| `full` (default) | .iflow/rules/project.md + .iflow/skills/<name>/SKILL.md    |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support       |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | Not supported |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
